profile.headline: Software Engineer Manager
profile.summary: Hands-on Engineering Manager with eight plus years leading embedded systems development from concept through production. Shipped IoT products generating tens of millions in sales while building and mentoring high-performing firmware teams. Combines deep technical expertise in embedded C, BLE, and real-time systems with cross-functional leadership across hardware, manufacturing, and product teams. Passionate about architecting reliable, safety-conscious systems for consumer and regulated industries.

positions.title: Software Engineer Manager
positions.description:
Leading a team of six firmware engineers delivering IoT-enabled product lines for a global consumer brand.
- Defines technical roadmap and architecture for all IoT product development, balancing innovation with manufacturability.
- Drives BLE implementation strategy, low-power sensor integration, and battery management optimization across product portfolio.
- Owns systems-level design decisions for controller-based devices interfacing with motors, fans, heating elements, and networked peripherals.
- Authors and maintains API documentation and communication protocols enabling seamless integration with companion apps.
positions.insights: Rust (Programming Language), Python (Programming Language) and +3 skills

positions.title: Firmware Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
Promoted to lead firmware architecture and mentor junior engineers while maintaining individual contributor responsibilities.

- Architected firmware for four simultaneous product lines across two flagship grill platforms, coordinating development timelines and technical dependencies.
- Established CI/CD pipeline reducing build validation time and catching integration issues earlier in development cycle.
- Designed memory-efficient solutions for resource-constrained MCUs, implementing robust fault recovery for high-voltage system interfaces.
- Created comprehensive functional documentation enabling faster onboarding and reducing tribal knowledge dependencies.
- Collaborated directly with hardware, product, program management, QA, manufacturing, and C-suite stakeholders.

positions.title: Electronics Product Engineer - R&D
positions.description:
Full-stack embedded engineer owning electrical and firmware design from schematic through production release.

- Delivered four products as sole electrical/firmware design lead, contributing to tens of thousands of accessory and appliance sales.
- Designed complete PCB solutions: schematic capture through 4-layer board layout with 30-40 unique components per design.
- Developed production firmware using FreeRTOS and bare-metal architectures with I2C, 1-Wire, CAN, and SPI peripherals.
- Built Python-based manufacturing test platform supporting 14+ test programs with multi-threading, failure logging, and predictive analytics.
- Provided real-time EMC troubleshooting during compliance testing, implementing on-the-spot fixes to maintain certification schedules.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Electrical Engineering and +3 skills

positions.title: Product Engineer Electrical
positions.description:
Led cross-functional initiatives spanning product launches, repair process engineering, and international team coordination.

- Launched repair program as primary engineer for 15+ consumer electronics products, designing test procedures that reduced unnecessary component replacement.
- Supervised engineering team at India office; traveled on-site to align processes and mentor staff on failure analysis techniques.
- Conducted technical interviews and onboarded Engineering Technicians, accelerating ramp-up through structured training programs.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer Technician
positions.description:
Developed reverse engineering and remanufacturing capabilities for consumer appliance control boards.

- Created test processes ensuring functional verification of remanufactured control boards prior to sale.
- Authored repair procedures and component upgrade specifications for production team execution.

projects.title: Swift App Development
projects.description:
Scribe, a reminder app with a role-playing game style.

Still in progress.

projects.title: X52 MFD Screen Integration Game Companion
projects.description:
Designed a companion app that works with the X52 Flight Controller. The app retrieves information from the Elite Dangerous game server and displays relevant details about the player on the screen of the controller.

Uses an SDK provided by Saitek to communicate with the controller. Written in C, C++.

View the Github page for information as to what currently being displayed.
